description: Ground elevation around Pacific Heights, San Francisco (37.7906, -122.4294): a crop of the Terrain that loadTerrain() builds for that place.
source: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (Mapzen), Terrarium tiles 14/2619-2620/6331-6332 and 11/326-328/790-792 from https://s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod/terrarium/ (underlying data: USGS NED/3DEP topobathy), retrieved 2026-11-14.
encoding: data = base64 of little-endian Int16 DECIMETRES above sea level; row-major, row 0 = southernmost; grid layout as in ElevationGrid (lib/types.ts). near is cropped to +-700 m of the place, far to +-6.5 km.
